title: Roads That Cannot Fail
statement:
A region has `n` towns and `m` two-way roads. A road is critical if closing it increases the number of groups of towns that can reach each other. Count the critical roads. The region may already be split into several groups.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `m`. Each of the next `m` lines contains the two towns joined by a road. No road is listed twice and no road joins a town to itself.

## Output
Print the number of critical roads.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 15000`
- `0 <= m <= 15000`
